name: Bone-Choir
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

abilities.name: Fear Aura
abilities.description: The bone-choir emanates an aura in a 20-foot radius while it is not incapacitated. Any enemy that starts its turn in the aura must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is frightened until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the target is immune to this creature's aura for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bone-choir makes three attacks, using Rib Lance or Dirge Bolt. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Eulogy Wrack or (B) Spellcasting to cast *Bestow Curse*.

actions.name: Rib Lance
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Dirge Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (5d8 + 4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Eulogy Wrack
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet of the bone-choir must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or take 28 (8d6) necrotic damage and be frightened of the bone-choir until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The bone-choir casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks): - **At will:** *Bestow Curse*, *Fear*, *Charm Person*
**1/day each:** *Vampiric Touch* (level 9 version)

actions.name: Choir's Call
actions.description: Each creature of the bone-choir's choice in a 90-foot radius originating from the bone-choir that can see or hear the bone-choir must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is charmed until the end of its next turn, and while charmed this way, it must move toward the bone-choir by the safest available route on its turn and can't take Reactions. On a successful save, the target is immune to this creature's lure for 24 hours.
